label: EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_2: it lies in the nature of x that x exists, unconditionally (essential truth)
term: existence belongs to the essence, essential truth (EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_2)
definition: EssentialExistence F Essential x := EssentialTruth Essential x (fun v => ExistsAt v x): it lies in the nature of x (ESSENCE_5, Fine's box-sub-x) that x exists, where the proposition is true exactly at the points where x exists. Unconditional: not 'if x exists, x exists'.
note: Stipulated for #1887. Sense EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_2 of the disambiguation f704b7ca-b455-4da7-a757-b0564fe76b3b. It is the consequent of the unconditional bridge 565ccd6c-0036-4613-8595-f6f03d273a0d. It implies the consequential form NatureEntailsExistence (EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_5); the converse needs closure of essence under entailment, which is not assumed. Distinct from NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_3 (OwnEssentialExistence), which is stated on a different profile type with existence facts; no bridge between them is encoded.
